ayahs.arabicText: اَلَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ صَدُّوْا عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ اَضَلَّ اَعْمَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Those who disbelieve and avert [people] from the way of Allah - He will waste their deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَ اٰمَنُوْا بِمَا نُزِّلَ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّهِمْ١ۙ كَفَّرَ عَنْهُمْ سَیِّاٰتِهِمْ وَ اَصْلَحَ بَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْبَاطِلَ وَ اَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّبَعُوا الْحَقَّ مِنْ رَّبِّهِمْ١ؕ كَذٰلِكَ یَضْرِبُ اللّٰهُ لِلنَّاسِ اَمْثَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does Allah present to the people their comparisons.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِذَا لَقِیْتُمُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَضَرْبَ الرِّقَابِ١ؕ حَتّٰۤى اِذَاۤ اَثْخَنْتُمُوْهُمْ فَشُدُّوا الْوَثَاقَ١ۙۗ فَاِمَّا مَنًّۢا بَعْدُ وَ اِمَّا فِدَآءً حَتّٰى تَضَعَ الْحَرْبُ اَوْزَارَهَا١ۛ۫ۚ۬ ذٰؔلِكَ١ۛؕ وَ لَوْ یَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ لَانْتَصَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَ لٰكِنْ لِّیَبْلُوَاۡ بَعْضَكُمْ بِبَعْضٍ١ؕ وَ الَّذِیْنَ قُتِلُوْا فِیْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ فَلَنْ یُّضِلَّ اَعْمَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds, and either [confer] favor afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if Allah had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of Allah - never will He waste their deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: سَیَهْدِیْهِمْ وَ یُصْلِحُ بَالَهُمْۚ
ayahs.translation: He will guide them and amend their condition

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یُدْخِلُهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَیُّهَا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْۤا اِنْ تَنْصُرُوا اللّٰهَ یَنْصُرْكُمْ وَ یُثَبِّتْ اَقْدَامَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, if you support Allah, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا فَتَعْسًا لَّهُمْ وَ اَضَلَّ اَعْمَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will waste their deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوْا مَاۤ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ فَاَحْبَطَ اَعْمَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: That is because they disliked what Allah revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَمْ یَسِیْرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ فَیَنْظُرُوْا كَیْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ١ؕ دَمَّرَ اللّٰهُ عَلَیْهِمْ١٘ وَ لِلْكٰفِرِیْنَ اَمْثَالُهَا
ayahs.translation: Have they not traveled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? Allah destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّ اللّٰهَ مَوْلَى الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ اَنَّ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ لَا مَوْلٰى لَهُمْ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: That is because Allah is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ یُدْخِلُ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ جَنّٰتٍ تَجْرِیْ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا الْاَنْهٰرُ١ؕ وَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا یَتَمَتَّعُوْنَ وَ یَاْكُلُوْنَ كَمَا تَاْكُلُ الْاَنْعَامُ وَ النَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, Allah will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ كَاَیِّنْ مِّنْ قَرْیَةٍ هِیَ اَشَدُّ قُوَّةً مِّنْ قَرْیَتِكَ الَّتِیْۤ اَخْرَجَتْكَ١ۚ اَهْلَكْنٰهُمْ فَلَا نَاصِرَ لَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: And how many a city was stronger than your city [Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ عَلٰى بَیِّنَةٍ مِّنْ رَّبِّهٖ كَمَنْ زُیِّنَ لَهٗ سُوْٓءُ عَمَلِهٖ وَ اتَّبَعُوْۤا اَهْوَآءَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?

ayahs.arabicText: مَثَلُ الْجَنَّةِ الَّتِیْ وُعِدَ الْمُتَّقُوْنَ١ؕ فِیْهَاۤ اَنْهٰرٌ مِّنْ مَّآءٍ غَیْرِ اٰسِنٍ١ۚ وَ اَنْهٰرٌ مِّنْ لَّبَنٍ لَّمْ یَتَغَیَّرْ طَعْمُهٗ١ۚ وَ اَنْهٰرٌ مِّنْ خَمْرٍ لَّذَّةٍ لِّلشّٰرِبِیْنَ١ۚ۬ وَ اَنْهٰرٌ مِّنْ عَسَلٍ مُّصَفًّى١ؕ وَ لَهُمْ فِیْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ وَ مَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنْ رَّبِّهِمْ١ؕ كَمَنْ هُوَ خَالِدٌ فِی النَّارِ وَ سُقُوْا مَآءً حَمِیْمًا فَقَطَّعَ اَمْعَآءَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْهُمْ مَّنْ یَّسْتَمِعُ اِلَیْكَ١ۚ حَتّٰۤى اِذَا خَرَجُوْا مِنْ عِنْدِكَ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِیْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ مَا ذَا قَالَ اٰنِفًا١۫ اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى قُلُوْبِهِمْ وَ اتَّبَعُوْۤا اَهْوَآءَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: And among them, [O Muhammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, "What has he said just now?" Those are the ones of whom Allah has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ اهْتَدَوْا زَادَهُمْ هُدًى وَّ اٰتٰىهُمْ تَقْوٰىهُمْ
ayahs.translation: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.

ayahs.arabicText: فَهَلْ یَنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَّا السَّاعَةَ اَنْ تَاْتِیَهُمْ بَغْتَةً١ۚ فَقَدْ جَآءَ اَشْرَاطُهَا١ۚ فَاَنّٰى لَهُمْ اِذَا جَآءَتْهُمْ ذِكْرٰىهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then what good to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?

ayahs.arabicText: فَاعْلَمْ اَنَّهٗ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَ اسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْۢبِكَ وَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِیْنَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنٰتِ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ یَعْلَمُ مُتَقَلَّبَكُمْ وَ مَثْوٰىكُمْ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except Allah and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And Allah knows of your movement and your resting place.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَقُوْلُ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا لَوْ لَا نُزِّلَتْ سُوْرَةٌ١ۚ فَاِذَاۤ اُنْزِلَتْ سُوْرَةٌ مُّحْكَمَةٌ وَّ ذُكِرَ فِیْهَا الْقِتَالُ١ۙ رَاَیْتَ الَّذِیْنَ فِیْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ یَّنْظُرُوْنَ اِلَیْكَ نَظَرَ الْمَغْشِیِّ عَلَیْهِ مِنَ الْمَوْتِ١ؕ فَاَوْلٰى لَهُمْۚ
ayahs.translation: Those who believe say, "Why has a surah not been sent down? But when a precise surah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is hypocrisy looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]

ayahs.arabicText: طَاعَةٌ وَّ قَوْلٌ مَّعْرُوْفٌ١۫ فَاِذَا عَزَمَ الْاَمْرُ١۫ فَلَوْ صَدَقُوا اللّٰهَ لَكَانَ خَیْرًا لَّهُمْۚ
ayahs.translation: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to Allah, it would have been better for them.

ayahs.arabicText: فَهَلْ عَسَیْتُمْ اِنْ تَوَلَّیْتُمْ اَنْ تُفْسِدُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ تُقَطِّعُوْۤا اَرْحَامَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللّٰهُ فَاَصَمَّهُمْ وَ اَعْمٰۤى اَبْصَارَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Those [who do so] are the ones that Allah has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَا یَتَدَبَّرُوْنَ الْقُرْاٰنَ اَمْ عَلٰى قُلُوْبٍ اَقْفَالُهَا
ayahs.translation: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ ارْتَدُّوْا عَلٰۤى اَدْبَارِهِمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَیَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدَى١ۙ الشَّیْطٰنُ سَوَّلَ لَهُمْ١ؕ وَ اَمْلٰى لَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمْ قَالُوْا لِلَّذِیْنَ كَرِهُوْا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ سَنُطِیْعُكُمْ فِیْ بَعْضِ الْاَمْرِ١ۖۚ وَ اللّٰهُ یَعْلَمُ اِسْرَارَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: That is because they said to those who disliked what Allah sent down, "We will obey you in part of the matter." And Allah knows what they conceal.

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَیْفَ اِذَا تَوَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ یَضْرِبُوْنَ وُجُوْهَهُمْ وَ اَدْبَارَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمُ اتَّبَعُوْا مَاۤ اَسْخَطَ اللّٰهَ وَ كَرِهُوْا رِضْوَانَهٗ فَاَحْبَطَ اَعْمَالَهُمْ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: That is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِیْنَ فِیْ قُلُوْبِهِمْ مَّرَضٌ اَنْ لَّنْ یُّخْرِجَ اللّٰهُ اَضْغَانَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَاَرَیْنٰكَهُمْ فَلَعَرَفْتَهُمْ بِسِیْمٰىهُمْ١ؕ وَ لَتَعْرِفَنَّهُمْ فِیْ لَحْنِ الْقَوْلِ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ یَعْلَمُ اَعْمَالَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And Allah knows your deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتّٰى نَعْلَمَ الْمُجٰهِدِیْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَ الصّٰبِرِیْنَ١ۙ وَ نَبْلُوَاۡ اَخْبَارَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of Allah] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ صَدُّوْا عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ وَ شَآقُّوا الرَّسُوْلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَیَّنَ لَهُمُ الْهُدٰى١ۙ لَنْ یَّضُرُّوا اللّٰهَ شَیْئًا١ؕ وَ سَیُحْبِطُ اَعْمَالَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them - never will they harm Allah at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَیُّهَا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْۤا اَطِیْعُوا اللّٰهَ وَ اَطِیْعُوا الرَّسُوْلَ وَ لَا تُبْطِلُوْۤا اَعْمَالَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: O you who have believed, obey Allah and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ صَدُّوْا عَنْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ مَاتُوْا وَ هُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَنْ یَّغْفِرَ اللّٰهُ لَهُمْ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, those who disbelieved and averted [people] from the path of Allah and then died while they were disbelievers - never will Allah forgive them.

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَا تَهِنُوْا وَ تَدْعُوْۤا اِلَى السَّلْمِ١ۖۗ وَ اَنْتُمُ الْاَعْلَوْنَ١ۖۗ وَ اللّٰهُ مَعَكُمْ وَ لَنْ یَّتِرَكُمْ اَعْمَالَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and Allah is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّمَا الْحَیٰوةُ الدُّنْیَا لَعِبٌ وَّ لَهْوٌ١ؕ وَ اِنْ تُؤْمِنُوْا وَ تَتَّقُوْا یُؤْتِكُمْ اُجُوْرَكُمْ وَ لَا یَسْئَلْكُمْ اَمْوَالَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear Allah, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ یَّسْئَلْكُمُوْهَا فَیُحْفِكُمْ تَبْخَلُوْا وَ یُخْرِجْ اَضْغَانَكُمْ
ayahs.translation: If He should ask you for them and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your unwillingness.

ayahs.arabicText: هٰۤاَنْتُمْ هٰۤؤُلَآءِ تُدْعَوْنَ لِتُنْفِقُوْا فِیْ سَبِیْلِ اللّٰهِ١ۚ فَمِنْكُمْ مَّنْ یَّبْخَلُ١ۚ وَ مَنْ یَّبْخَلْ فَاِنَّمَا یَبْخَلُ عَنْ نَّفْسِهٖ١ؕ وَ اللّٰهُ الْغَنِیُّ وَ اَنْتُمُ الْفُقَرَآءُ١ۚ وَ اِنْ تَتَوَلَّوْا یَسْتَبْدِلْ قَوْمًا غَیْرَكُمْ١ۙ ثُمَّ لَا یَكُوْنُوْۤا اَمْثَالَكُمْ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of Allah - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and Allah is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away, He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.
